evidence.detail: Exact-v308 getDisplayName() returns 'RuneLite'; the constructor loads RuneLite.colorschemes and named schemes such as RuneLite Active, RuneLite Enabled, RuneLite Border, RuneLite Watermark and RuneLite Header Border.
Class extends SubstanceSkin and configures RuneLite color-scheme bundles, painters, overlays, borders and a zero-radius button shaper.
Core R8D independently identified rs/gui/b -> Class.getResource('RuneLite.colorschemes') as a package-relative runtime-sensitive resource lookup.

proposals.note: RuneLiteSkin follows the exact display/resource identity and SubstanceSkin role.

evidence.detail: Exact-v308 class extends org.pushingpixels.substance.api.SubstanceLookAndFeel and its constructor installs raw rs/gui/b as the active SubstanceSkin.
The installed skin identifies itself and all of its scheme resources as RuneLite, fixing this class as the look-and-feel wrapper for that skin.

proposals.note: Semantic name describes the exact wrapper role; it is not claimed as recovered original source text.
